notes:
Summary: enterprise support SaaS provider (customer-facing ticketing + bot) looking to replace aging in-house assist and improve RAG fidelity. Primary driver: reduce time-to-resolution for tier 1 by 30% and reduce agent ramp time via high-quality assist suggestions with provenance.

Key pain: hallucinations during escalations; stale KB answers; connectors to Zendesk/Confluence are brittle; spikes during product launches make current system drop suggestions (time-outs). Wants citations-first UX: show doc snippet + link, then suggested action.

Quote from VP Support on 2026-02-14 call: "If the model can't cite a doc we can't send that to an agent in a live escalation — provenance is non-negotiable."

Technical requirements (customer language):
- Ingest connectors: Zendesk, Confluence, S3 buckets, Postgres changelogs, product release notes feed (RSS)
- Freshness target: <= 24h for release notes, <= 48h for FAQ/KB sync
- Citation-level provenance: snippet + source + timestamp; prefer line-level offsets for legal/agent audit
- Retrieval: multi-source ranking (prefer recency + semantic relevance), de-dup across sources, per-route reranking ability
- Latency SLOs: agent-suggestion < 250ms P95 on warm path; document retrieval + scoring end-to-end < 400ms for 95% of queries
- Throughput target: 200 concurrent online agents (steady) with 3x burst to 600 during launches; expected ~1.2k qps at peak read-only retrievals
- Tool-calling: ticket update, create escalation, add internal note; requires function/tool calling with RBAC and audit trail
- Fallbacks: deterministic fallback to keyword search UI when model uncertain; clear confidence thresholds and auto-escalation rules

POC plan (6 weeks):
- Week 0: security review + SSO test (okta sandbox)
- Week 1: connectors: ingest last 12 months of KB + release notes, initial vector store
- Week 2–3: relevance tuning (prompt templates + reranker), citation formatting, evaluation sets
- Week 4: scale test: simulate 600 concurrent agents + search load, measure latency and tail behavior
- Week 5–6: pilot with 50 agents, QA feedback loop, metrics: citation precision, RFS (resolution from suggestion), agent satisfaction

Success metrics: citation precision >= 92%, pilot RFS uplift +20%, mean time to suggested action < 12s, no production hallucination incident in pilot.

Notes/shorthand from calls:
- "need per-route dashboards, token-level cost split" — ops ask
- Legal asking for KMS + external audit rights for EU tenancy
- Wants optional private deployment for regulated EU customers; will evaluate Redwood Private vs Dedicated pools

Jira/ops integration: critical. They run ServiceNow for escalations but Zendesk for tickets — tool-calling needs connectors to both. Also want webhooks to push agent actions to internal analytics.

POC expectations vs success: they want a clear degradation path (fallback policies) and deterministic behavior under load — reliability > model novelty.
